title: Illustration / Characters / Body types / Shoulders
slide_intent: Conceal construction joints and reduce unnecessary pieces so a viewer reads a clear silhouette rather than the assembly.
strategic_value: A simple shoulder connection can help Duolingo preserve its uncluttered character style through posing.
demonstration: Two translucent figures compare a concealed shoulder connection with an overbuilt version marked by a pale red prohibition frame.
practical_value: Place the arm socket behind the torso and remove extra shapes that complicate the outline.
